## Alerts & Interventions

### ⚪ Critical Low Free T

Free Testosterone is 0.251 nmol/L (BR-H02 < 0.30).

**Recommended actions:**

Clinical review required.

### 🔴 Low Testosterone

Total Testosterone is 12.7 nmol/L (BR-H01 12–14.9).

**Recommended actions:**

Contact Manual clinic — discuss dose adjustment.

### 🔴 High Leg Asymmetry

Leg asymmetry is 0.20 kg (BR-B05 0.2–0.4kg).

**Recommended actions:**

Add dedicated unilateral session: extra set right leg per exercise.

### 🟡 Suboptimal Oestradiol

Oestradiol is 95.1 pmol/L (BR-H03 75–99).

**Recommended actions:**

Monitor libido, joint comfort, mood; may be suboptimal.

### 🟡 Elevated SHBG

SHBG is 32.1 nmol/L (BR-H04 30–40).

**Recommended actions:**

Consider boron 6–10mg/day; recheck in 6–8 weeks.

### 🟡 Fat Mass Increasing

Fat mass is 14.4 kg (BR-B02 13–14.5kg).

**Recommended actions:**

Tighten nutrition; ensure caloric surplus not excessive.

### 🟡 Suboptimal Boditrax Score

Boditrax score is 809 (BR-B08 800–819).

**Recommended actions:**

Solid; review which sub-components are dragging.

### 🟡 Low Calcium Intake

Calcium is below 800 mg on 14/14 recent logged days (average: 133).

**Recommended actions:**

- Add dairy, fortified foods, or leafy greens
- Consider supplementation if consistently low

### 🟡 Low Vitamin C Intake

Vitamin C is below 60 %DV on 10/14 recent logged days (average: 49).

**Recommended actions:**

- Eat more citrus fruits, peppers, and berries
- Vitamin C supports immune function and collagen synthesis

### 🟡 Low Iron Intake

Iron is below 80 %DV on 14/14 recent logged days (average: 10).

**Recommended actions:**

- Include iron-rich foods: red meat, lentils, spinach
- Pair with vitamin C for better absorption

### 🟡 Arm Muscle Asymmetry

Arm muscle imbalance: L=4.40 kg, R=4.10 kg (7.1% difference, right side weaker).

**Recommended actions:**

- Add unilateral exercises targeting the right arm
- Start sets with the weaker side and match reps on the stronger side
- >5% asymmetry increases injury risk — address proactively
